blocks.text: With Robert Pattinson officially taking over as the new James Bond, attention is now turning to who will be his leading lady in the next installment of the long-running spy franchise. While no actress has been officially announced for the female lead, among those being considered by fans and critics for the coveted role are Zendaya, Margaret Qualley, Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy, Anna Sawai, Daisy Edgar-Jones, and Adria Arjona. A November 15 report by Vogue explored 45 actresses who could potentially become the next generation of Bond girls, mentioning the above names alongside others being discussed by movie fans.
